## Summary

## Related issues

## Behavior and risk

<!--
Describe observable changes and any compatibility, bounded-resource, security,
failure, or dependency/license impact. Note unsupported options explicitly.
For documentation or infrastructure-only changes, say whether runtime behavior is unchanged.

## Validation

<!--
List exact commands and results; identify unrun checks and why they were not run.
For bug fixes, identify the regression test that fails before the fix.
Performance claims need raw benchmark evidence and environment metadata.
Only check items below after reviewing them; explain anything not applicable.
-->

- [ ] The change is scoped, and any required major-change proposal is linked.
- [ ] Regression, boundary, and error-side-effect tests are added or updated where relevant.
- [ ] Documentation reflects any changed behavior, or no documentation change is needed.
- [ ] Compatibility, bounded-resource, and security impact is addressed where relevant; unsupported options are not silently accepted.
- [ ] Commit messages and the final squash title follow Conventional Commits; Release Please owns version/changelog updates, with no manual version bumps or release tags in this ordinary PR.
- [ ] I am authorized to submit this work under Apache-2.0; provenance and authorship are accurate, with no copied Redis source.
- [ ] No secrets, private data, generated executables, or unreviewed license/advisory suppressions are included.
